quote: We propose two conversion methods, i.e., cells-to-sentences and sentences-to-tables for the original tabular evidence and textual evidence, respectively.

We propose a dual channel unified format verification model (DCUF) to allow each evidence piece encoded in its original format and maximally maintain its original rich context, while encouraging further interactions with other evidence.
